This could use a better name.  em_utils::EMUtils doesn't give a lot of indication on what it is.

Maybe PowerStatusMonitor ?
Agree. Done.
if this is now a class, it doesn't really belong in utils any longer.  Maybe these need to move to power_status_monitor.cpp/hpp?

Yes, good point. I create the `power_status_monitor.hpp` in this patch
but move the member functions in a separate patch since it should be easier to look at if they are only moved and otherwise unchanged.
SOunds good
Do you know why unique_ptr is required here?   Now that it's a class, I wouldn't expect to need that.  I would expect match can be used as is and constructed in the constructor.

I am using `std::unique_ptr` here to preserve the original control flow where the `setupPowerMatch` is called to create the match.

I did not want to look into the implication of changing that control flow just yet since this patch is focused on removing the global variable.
Made the requested change in a follow-up patch https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/82289
ACK.  Followon patch is fine.
This is fine, though I would have preferred you put the functions in the new cpp in this commit.
